# Phase 1 Data Model: VSDService — Local ReadVSD

**Feature**: 011-read-vsd | **Date**: 2026-06-18

The feature is **stateless** — no JPA entities, no database tables. The "data model"
below describes the in-memory value objects passed between the SOAP edge
(`KonnektorVSDService`) and the card-level orchestrator (`ReadVsdService`), plus the
eGK on-card file map that the read targets. Generated SOAP types
(`de.gematik.ws.conn.vsds.vsdservice.v5_2.*`) are the wire contract; the value objects
below are the internal domain representation that maps to them.

---

## 1. Wire types (generated by `wsdl2java`, not hand-written)

From `conn/vsds/VSDService.xsd` (namespace `…/VSDService/v5.2`):

| Type | Fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ReadVSD` | `EhcHandle:string`, `HpcHandle:string`, `PerformOnlineCheck:boolean`, `ReadOnlineReceipt:boolean`, `Context:ContextType` | Request. `Context` = `de.gematik.ws.conn.connectorcontext.v2.ContextType` (MandantId, ClientSystemId, WorkplaceId, UserId). |
| `ReadVSDResponse` | `PersoenlicheVersichertendaten:base64Binary`, `AllgemeineVersicherungsdaten:base64Binary`, `GeschuetzteVersichertendaten:base64Binary?`, `VSD_Status:VSD_StatusType`, `Pruefungsnachweis:base64Binary?` | `GeschuetzteVersichertendaten` optional; `Pruefungsnachweis` **never set** by this feature. |
| `VSD_StatusType` | `Status:string("[01]")`, `Timestamp:dateTime`, `Version:string("\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,4}")` | Built from `VsdStatus`. |
| `Error` | gematik `TelematikError` (MessageID, Timestamp, Trace[Code, Severity, ErrorText, …]) | Carried by `FaultMessage`. |

---

## 2. Internal value objects (`de.servicehealtherx.apdu.vsdm`)

### VsdReadResult (orchestrator output)

| Field | Type | Description | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `personalData` | `byte[]` | EF.PD content, **raw card bytes** (gzip-compressed on card), returned unchanged | EF.PD via TUC_KON_202 |
| `generalData` | `byte[]` | EF.VD content (VD portion only, honouring start/end offsets) | EF.VD via TUC_KON_202 |
| `protectedData` | `Optional<byte[]>` | EF.GVD content; empty when C2C did not authorise protected access | EF.GVD via TUC_KON_202 |
| `status` | `VsdStatus` | converted VSD status | EF.StatusVD via TUC_KON_202 + `StatusVdConverter` |

Validation / invariants:
- `personalData`, `generalData`, `status` are **always** present on a successful read
  (FR-004, FR-019). `protectedData` is present **iff** C2C authorised GVD (FR-021).
- Byte arrays are passed to the SOAP layer which Base64-encodes them verbatim (FR-005)
  — **no gzip decompression, no XML parsing** of PD/VD/GVD.
- `VsdReadResult` is short-lived: created per call, never logged, never persisted, and
  eligible for GC immediately after the response is marshalled (FR-028).

### VsdStatus

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | `char` / `String("0"|"1")` | `0` = consistent / no open transactions; `1` = inconsistent |
| `timestamp` | `OffsetDateTime` | last VSD update, rendered to `dateTime` |
| `version` | `String` | schema version, e.g. `7.3.1` |

Derivation (`StatusVdConverter`, Tab_FM_VSDM_21 — VSDM-A_2708 / A_3063):
- `Status` byte → `"0"`/`"1"`.
- `Timestamp` BCD `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS` (e.g. `20120131084713`) → `2012-01-31T08:47:13`.
- `Version` BCD (e.g. `0x00 70 03 00 01`) → `7.3.1`; `Version_Speicherstruktur`
  **not** transferred; an unknown storage-structure version aborts (VSDM-A_2979).

### ReadVsdRequest (internal, normalised from the SOAP `ReadVSD`)

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ehcHandle` | `String` | eGK card handle (`EhcHandle`) |
| `hpcHandle` | `String` | HBA/SMC-B card handle (`HpcHandle`) |
| `mandantId` / `clientSystemId` / `workplaceId` | `String` | always required (FR-002) |
| `userId` | `Optional<String>` | required when `hpcHandle` → HBA (FR-002) |

Precondition checks (reject before any card access):
- `PerformOnlineCheck == false` else fault (FR-007); `ReadOnlineReceipt == false` else
  fault (FR-008).
- Mandatory context IDs present (FR-002); `userId` present for HBA.

### VsdmReadException (internal → SOAP fault)

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `errorCode` | `int` | VSDM code (3001, 3011, 3041, 3042) or OM code (106, 107, 114) |
| `affectedContainer` / `cardHandle` | `String?` | detail text (e.g. which container / which card) — **no PII** |

Maps to `de.gematik.ws.tel.error.v2.Error` (Severity `Fatal`, single Trace, EventID,
LogReference) via `VsdmFaultFactory` (FR-024, FR-025; no stack traces — VSDM-A_2682).

---

## 3. eGK on-card file map (read targets — `EgkVsdmFile` enum + `GematikISO7816`)

Application **DF.HCA** (Healthcareapplication), AID `D2 76 00 00 01 02`.

| EF | FID | Access to read | Returned | Afo |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EF.StatusVD` | (object-system FID) | AlwaysRead | parsed → `VsdStatus` | VSDM-A_2660, A_2708 |
| `EF.PD` | (object-system FID) | AlwaysRead | `personalData` (raw) | VSDM-A_2567–2571 |
| `EF.VD` | (object-system FID) | AlwaysRead (honour VD start/end offset) | `generalData` (raw) | VSDM-A_2784 |
| `EF.GVD` | (object-system FID) | **requires C2C-authenticated HBA/SMC-B role** | `protectedData` (raw) | VSDM-A_2572–2574 |
| `EF.Logging` (audit) | (object-system FID) | append after C2C | written, not returned | VSDM-A_2586/2587/2654 |

> Concrete FID/SFID byte values and the precise access-rule matrix are confirmed in
> `contracts/egk-vsdm-files.md` (from gemSpec_eGK_ObjSys). `EF.GVD` is the only read
> target gated by C2C; PD/VD/StatusVD are AlwaysRead, which backs the FR-019/FR-021
> guarantee that PD+VD+Status are returned even when GVD authorisation is absent.

---

## 4. State / lifecycle

`ReadVSD` is a single transient transaction over the eGK card session — there is no
long-lived entity to model. The relevant lifecycle is the **eGK reservation** during
one call (reserve → read → release), shown in `diagrams/state-readvsd.puml`. A second
concurrent call for the same eGK fails fast at the reserve step (FR-029).
